clinic.name: Seasons of Smiles Dental
clinic.heroSubtitle: Restore your confidence and function with permanent, titanium-rooted dental implants. We combine Digital Smile Design and a relaxing atmosphere to replace missing teeth with natural-looking results.

differentiators.title: Advanced Digital Technology
differentiators.description: We utilize Digital Smile Design and iTero 3D scans to plan precise implant placements and predictable aesthetic outcomes.

differentiators.title: In-House Insurance Savings
differentiators.description: Our unique in-house program offers significant discounts on procedures, saving patients upwards of $1,000 on major work.

differentiators.title: Patient-Centered Comfort
differentiators.description: We prioritize a relaxing environment with options like nitrous oxide to transform the typical dental experience into one patients love.

differentiators.title: Full-Arch Expertise
differentiators.description: Our practice specializes in restorative solutions ranging from single implants to complex implant-supported dentures and bridges.

treatmentJourney.title: Consultation & 3D Imaging
treatmentJourney.description: We begin with a thorough assessment and 3D iTero scans to map out your unique bone structure and ideal smile goals.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Smile Design
treatmentJourney.description: Using Digital Smile Design, we create a visual preview of your final results, ensuring the perfect shade and fit before we begin.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Medina expertly places the titanium implant into the jawbone using modern technology and comfort-focused techniques.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Integration
treatmentJourney.description: Over several months, the implant undergoes osseointegration, naturally fusing with your bone to create a rock-solid foundation.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Restoration Fitting
treatmentJourney.description: Once healed, we take precise impressions to craft your custom implant crown, bridge, or denture that matches your natural teeth.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Smile Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: We secure your permanent restoration, leaving you with a beautiful, functional smile and a plan for long-term health.

benefits.title: Stress-Free Environment
benefits.description: Experience a relaxing and light-hearted atmosphere designed to ease dental anxiety for patients of all ages.

benefits.title: Digital Smile Design
benefits.description: Preview your dental implant results before treatment starts using advanced 3D imaging and shade-matching technology.

benefits.title: Comfort Options
benefits.description: We offer nitrous oxide and gentle techniques to ensure your implant surgery is as comfortable and pleasant as possible.

benefits.title: Modern Implant Tech
benefits.description: Our office utilizes the latest equipment and updated technology for precise and long-lasting tooth replacement.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Restorations
benefits.description: From single crowns to full implant bridges, we provide complete care from the first consultation to your final smile.

implantOptions.title: Single Tooth Implant
implantOptions.description: A permanent replacement for a single missing tooth that preserves the health of your surrounding natural teeth.

implantOptions.title: Implant Bridges
implantOptions.description: Stable, multi-tooth restorations supported by titanium implants to bridge the gap left by several missing teeth.

implantOptions.title: Implant Dentures
implantOptions.description: Secure, implant-supported dentures that eliminate slipping and provide the confidence to eat and speak naturally.

implantOptions.title: Implant Crowns
implantOptions.description: Custom-crafted, aesthetic crowns designed to attach to implants for a seamless and durable smile restoration.

faqItems.question: How long does the dental implant process take?
faqItems.answer: The journey typically involves several stages over a few months, including planning, placement, and a healing period to ensure the implant is securely integrated with your jawbone.

faqItems.question: How much do dental implants cost?
faqItems.answer: Costs vary based on your specific needs, but we offer an in-house insurance program and financing options that have saved our patients thousands on restorative work.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for implants if I have bone loss?
faqItems.answer: We use 3D imaging and Digital Smile Design to assess your jaw health. Many patients with bone loss can still receive implants following preparation or bone grafting.

faqItems.question: Does dental implant surgery hurt?
faqItems.answer: Your comfort is our primary concern. We provide a relaxing setting and options like nitrous oxide to ensure you feel minimal discomfort during the procedure.

faqItems.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and regular checkups at Seasons of Smiles, titanium dental implants are designed to be a permanent, lifelong solution for missing teeth.

faqItems.question: Are you accepting new patients for restorative work?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we always welcome new patients from Camden, Rockport, and the Midcoast area seeking to restore their smiles with implants or other advanced treatments.

doctor.name: Norman Medina
doctor.bio: Norman Medina, DDS, has been providing high-quality dental care to the Midcoast Maine community for decades. He is known for his professional expertise and commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in dental technology, including Digital Smile Design and implant restorations. Dr. Medina focuses on making every visit relaxing and enjoyable, particularly for patients with dental anxiety. His patient-first philosophy ensures that comfort is always the primary concern during every procedure.

reviews.name: Eric V.
reviews.text: I’ve been going there for a little over a year. I needed a good deal of work done and they’ve done a great job, including an implant. Their insurance is a great deal.

reviews.text: I am thrilled with my crowns and the quality of work. The office is spotless, the equipment looks perfect, and Dr. Medina gave me a great feeling of confidence.

reviews.name: Jon V.
reviews.text: Dr. Medina is professional and highly knowledgeable with updated technology. I'm usually not comfortable at the dentist, but here I feel at home. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Coni F.
reviews.text: It was wonderful!! The staff was very friendly and made you feel like you have been going there forever. I highly recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.name: Russell V.

reviews.name: Dianne S.
